solution.analysis_md:
\(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{(1 + x)^{\frac{2}{x}} - \mathrm{e}^{2}[1 - \ln (1 + x)]}{x}\)
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {2}{x} \ln (1 + x)} - \mathrm{e} ^ {2} [ 1 - \ln (1 + x) ]}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {2}{x} \ln (1 + x)} - \mathrm{e} ^ {2} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2} \ln (1 + x)}{x}
\]
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {2}{x} \ln (1 + x)} - \mathrm{e} ^ {2}}{x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2} = \mathrm{e} ^ {2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {2}{x} \ln (1 + x) - 2}{x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2}
\]
\[
= \mathrm{e} ^ {2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {2}{x} \ln (1 + x) - 2}{x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2} = 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (1 + x) - x}{x ^ {2}} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2}
\]
\[
= 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{1 + x} - 1}{2 x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2} = - \mathrm{e} ^ {2} + \mathrm{e} ^ {2} = 0
\]
A 正确.

questions.stem: 设 \( f(x) \) 在 \([0, +\infty)\) 上有连续导数，且 \( f'(x) > 0 \). 当 \( 0 < a < x < b \) 时，有

solution.analysis_md:
解式 令 \(F(x) = \int_{0}^{x} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t\)，则 \(F(0) = 0\). 记 \(G(x) = \frac{F(x)}{x}\)，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} G ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {x F ^ {\prime} (x) - F (x)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x F ^ {\prime} (x) - [ F (x) - F (0) ]}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {x F ^ {\prime} (x) - x F ^ {\prime} (\xi)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x [ f (x) - f (\xi) ]}{x ^ {2}} \quad (0 <   \xi <   x <   b) \\ \end{array}
\]
由 \(f^{\prime}(x) > 0\) ，知 \(f(x)\) 单调递增，故 \(f(x) > f(\xi)\) ，所以 \(G^{\prime}(x) > 0\) ，从而 \(G(x)\) 单调递增，故
\[
G (x) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{x} <   G (b) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {b} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{b}
\]
即 \(b\int_{0}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t <   x\int_{0}^{b}f(t)\mathrm{d}t.\)
B 正确.

questions.stem: 设 \( y_1(x) \) 与 \( y_2(x) \) 是非齐次微分方程 \( y' + P(x)y = Q(x) \) 的两个解. 若 \( \lambda y_1(x) + \mu y_2(x) \) 仍是该方程的解, 则 \( e^{\lambda^3 + \mu^3} \) 的最小值为

solution.analysis_md:
依题设 \(\lambda y_{1}(x) + \mu y_{2}(x)\) 仍是非齐次微分方程 \(y' + P(x)y = Q(x)\) 的解的充分必要条件是 \(\lambda + \mu = 1\)，求 \(\mathrm{e}^{\lambda^3 + \mu^3}\) 的最小值，只要求 \(\lambda^3 + \mu^3\) 在条件 \(\lambda + \mu = 1\) 下的最小值。由 \(\mu = 1 - \lambda\)，有 \(\lambda^3 + \mu^3 = \lambda^3 + (1 - \lambda)^3 \stackrel{\text{记}}{=} f(\lambda)\)，则
\[
f ^ {\prime} (\lambda) = 3 \lambda^ {2} + 3 (1 - \lambda) ^ {2} \cdot (- 1) = 3 [ \lambda^ {2} - (1 - \lambda) ^ {2} ] = 3 (2 \lambda - 1)
\]
由 \(f^{\prime}(\lambda) = 0\) ，得 \(\lambda = \frac{1}{2}\) ；又 \(f^{\prime \prime}(\lambda) = 6 > 0\) ，知 \(f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 +\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 = \frac{1}{4}\) 为 \(\lambda^3 +\mu^3\) 的最小值.C正确.

questions.stem: 下列积分发散的是

solution.analysis_md:
对于 D, 有  \( \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} e^{|x|} \sin x \, dx = \int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{-x} \sin x \, dx + \int_{0}^{+\infty} e^{x} \sin x \, dx \) .
由 \(\int_0^b\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^x (\sin x - \cos x)\bigg|_0^b = \frac{1}{2}\left[\mathrm{e}^b (\sin b - \cos b) + 1\right]\)
可知 \(\lim_{b\to +\infty}\int_0^b\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 不存在，故 \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散，从而 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{|x|}\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散.D正确.对于A，由 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}x^{\frac{7}{2}}\cdot \frac{1}{x^3\sqrt{1 + x}} = 1.\) 根据比较审敛法，知 \(\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^3\sqrt{1 + x}}\) 收敛.
对于 B,  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty} x^{2} e^{-x} dx = \Gamma(3) = 2 \) . 故原积分收敛.
对于 C,  \( \int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x\ln^{2}x}=\int_{2}^{+\infty}(\ln x)^{-2}\mathrm{d}(\ln x)=-\frac{1}{\ln x}\bigg|_{2}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{\ln2} \) ，故原积分收敛.

questions.stem:
下列结论正确的是
①若 \(f(x)\) 在 \(x = a\) 处连续，且 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^2}\) 存在，则 \(f'(a)\) 存在.
②若 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}n\left[f\left(a + \frac{1}{n}\right) - f(a)\right](n\) 为正整数)存在，则 \(f^{\prime}(a)\) 存在.
③若 \(f(x) = (x - a)\varphi (x)\) ，其中 \(\varphi (x)\) 在 \(x = a\) 处连续，则 \(f^{\prime}(a)\) 存在.
④存在 \(\delta > 0\), 对 \(\forall x \in (a - \delta, a + \delta)\), 有 \(|f(x)| \leqslant L|x - a|^{\alpha}\), 其中 \(L > 0, \alpha > 1\) 为常数, 则 \(f'(a)\) 存在.

solution.analysis_md:
由①不能推出 \(f^{\prime}(a)\) 存在, 因为
\(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^2} = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^3}\cdot x\) 存在，有可能 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^3}\)
为 \(\infty\) (因 \(\infty \cdot 0\) 型极限可能存在).
由 ②不能推出  \( f'(a) \)  存在.
如 \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x\sin \frac{\pi}{x}, & x \neq 0, \\ 0, & x = 0, \end{cases}\) 则 \(\lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{f(0 + \Delta x) - f(0)}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \sin \frac{\pi}{\Delta x}\) 不存在，即 \(f'(0)\) 不
存在,但 \( \lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)-f(0)}{\frac{1}{n}}=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sin n\pi=0. \)
由 ③ 可推出 \( f(x) \) 在 \( x = a \) 处可导.
\[
f ^ {\prime} (a) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {(x - a) \varphi (x) - 0}{x - a} = \varphi (a)
\]
由 ④ 可推出  \( f'(a) \)  存在.
由 \(|f(x)| \leqslant L |x - a|^{\alpha}\), 知 \(f(a) = 0\), 且
\[
0 \leqslant \left| \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} \right| \leqslant L | x - a | ^ {\alpha - 1}, \quad x \in (a - \delta , a + \delta)
\]
因 \(\alpha > 1\)，知 \(\lim_{x \to a} L |x - a|^{\alpha - 1} = 0\). 故由夹逼准则知 \(\lim_{x \to a} \left| \frac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a} \right| = 0\)，从而
\[
f ^ {\prime} (a) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} = 0
\]
综上所述，D 正确.

questions.stem: 积分 \(\int_{0}^{2} dx \int_{\sqrt{3} x^2} f\left(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\right) \mathrm{d}y =\)

solution.analysis_md:
由极坐标, 可知
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {\sqrt {3} x} ^ {x} f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) \mathrm{d} y = - \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \sec \theta} f (r) r \mathrm{d} r
\]
可排除 A, B. 对极坐标交换顺序, 有
\[
- \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \sec \theta} f (r) r \mathrm{d} r = - \int_ {0} ^ {2 \sqrt {2}} \mathrm{d} r \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} f (r) r \mathrm{d} \theta - \int_ {2 \sqrt {2}} ^ {4} \mathrm{d} r \int_ {\arccos \frac {2}{r}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} f (r) r \mathrm{d} \theta
\]
C 正确.

设 \(A\) 是 \(m \times n\) 矩阵, 则非齐次线性方程组 \(AX = b\) 有解的充分必要条件是

solution.analysis_md:
\(\mathbf{A}_{m\times n}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{b}\) 有解 \(\Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) = \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{b})\Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}) = \mathrm{r}\left[(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{b})^{\mathrm{T}}\right] = \mathrm{r}\left[\begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}}\end{array}\right]\)
\(\Leftrightarrow \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 基础解个数相等
因 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解必满足 \(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) ，故 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{b}\) 有解 \(\Leftrightarrow \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 同解. D正确.
对于选项 A, r(A) = m(A 行满秩), 则 r(A) = r(A, b) = m. 故 AX = b 有解; 但 AX = b 有解, 未必有 r(A) = m.
对于选项 B, AX = b 有解  \( \Leftrightarrow r(A) = r(A, b) \) ，但  \( r(A) \)  未必为 n.
对于选项 C, 由前面推导知, AX = b 有解  \( \Leftrightarrow r(A^{T}) = r \begin{bmatrix} A^{T} \\ b^{T} \end{bmatrix} \) , 但秩未必为 m.

questions.stem: 设 \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & a \end{bmatrix}\) 与 \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\) 合同, 则

solution.analysis_md:
实对称矩阵 A 与 B 合同的充分必要条件是它们有相同的正、负惯性指数.
由 \(|\lambda E - B| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\lambda -1 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & \lambda -1 & -1\\ 0 & -1 & \lambda \end{array} \right| = (\lambda -1)(\lambda^2 -\lambda -1) = 0\)
得 B 的特征值为  \( \lambda_{1}=1>0,\lambda_{2}=\frac{1-\sqrt{5}}{2}<0,\lambda_{3}=\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}>0. \)
由 \(|\mu E - A| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\mu -2 & -1 & 0\\ -1 & \mu -2 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & \mu -a \end{array} \right| = (\mu -a)(\mu -3)(\mu -1) = 0\)
得 A 的特征值为  \( \mu_{1}=a,\mu_{2}=3,\mu_{3}=1 \) .
故 \(a < 0\). B 正确.

questions.stem: 设 4 阶实矩阵 \(A = (a_{ij}) = (a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4), a_{11}\) 的代数余子式 \(A_{11} \neq 0\), 且 \(|A| = 0\), 则下列选项正确的是

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(|\mathbf{A}| = 0\) ，知 \(\mathbf{A}^{*}\mathbf{A} = |\mathbf{A}|\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{O}\) ，故
\[
\mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A} ^ {*}) + \mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A}) \leqslant 4
\]
又由 \(A_{11} \neq 0\)，知 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) \geqslant 1\)，所以 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) \leqslant 3\). 当 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) < 3\) 时，\(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 0\)，与 \(A_{11} \neq 0\) 矛盾.
故 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) = 3, \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 1\).
由 \(A_{11} = \left| \begin{array}{lll}a_{22} & a_{23} & a_{24}\\ a_{32} & a_{33} & a_{34}\\ a_{42} & a_{43} & a_{44} \end{array} \right|\neq 0\) ，知 \(\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{22}\\ a_{32}\\ a_{42} \end{array} \right|,\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{23}\\ a_{33}\\ a_{43} \end{array} \right|,\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{24}\\ a_{34}\\ a_{44} \end{array} \right|\) 线性无关，故 \(\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4}\) 线性无关，
排除 A.
而  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  不一定线性无关, 排除 B、D.
由  \( \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*})=1 \)  , 知  \( A^{*}X=0 \)  , 有  \( 4-\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*})=3 \)  个线性无关解.
又由  \( A^{*}A=O \) ，知 A 的列向量  \( \alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4} \)  均是  \( A^{*}X=0 \)  的解，故 C 正确.

questions.stem: 曲线 \( y = (x + 1)(\mathrm{e}^{nx} - 1)(n > 1) \) 与 \( x \) 轴所围图形的面积为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
解 令 \(y = 0\) ，得 \(x = -1\) 或 \(x = 0\) ，所求面积为
\[
\begin{array}{l} S = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} | (x + 1) \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {n x} - 1\right) | \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \left(1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {n x}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \frac {1}{2} (x + 1) ^ {2} \left| _ {- 1} ^ {0} - \frac {1}{n} \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {n x}) \right. \\ = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{n} \left[ (x + 1) \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {0} - \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{n} \left(1 - \frac {1}{n} \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {0}\right) = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{n} + \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- n}) \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem: 设 \( f(t) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{[n + (t - 1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t - 1}{n}i}} (t > 1) \)，则 \( \lim_{t\to +\infty}f(t) = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
解 \(f(t) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{[n + (t - 1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t - 1}{n}i}} = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{n\left(1 + \frac{t - 1}{n}i\right)\sqrt{1 + \frac{t - 1}{n}i} - 1}\)
\[
= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {t - 1}{n}}{\left(1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i} - 1} = \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}}
\]
故 \(\lim_{t\to +\infty}f(t) = \lim_{t\to +\infty}\int_{1}^{t}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} = \int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} = \int_{1}^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} +\int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}}\)
\[
= \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \int_ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {2} ^ {b} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} = \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \left| _ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \right| _ {2} ^ {b} \\ = \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - 2 \arctan \sqrt {\xi}\right) + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {b - 1} - \frac {\pi}{2} \\ = \frac {\pi}{2} - 0 + \pi - \frac {\pi}{2} = \pi \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem: 设函数 \( y = y(x) \) 由 \( \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = t^2 + 2t \\ \frac{1}{2}\sin y - y + t^2 = 1 \end{array} \right. \) (\( t > 0 \)) 确定，则 \( \left. \frac{d^2y}{dx^2} \right|_{x=3} = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
已知方程组同时对 \(t\) 求导, 得
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} t} = 2 t + 2 \\ \frac {1}{2} \cos y \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + 2 t = 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
解得 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = 2(t + 1), \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{2t}{1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos y}\), 故 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{t}{(t + 1)(1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos y)}\).
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right) \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right) ^ {2} - t ^ {2} (t + 1) \sin y}{2 (t + 1) ^ {3} \left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right) ^ {3}}
\]
当 \(x = 3\) 时，\(t = 1, y = 0\)，故 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2}\bigg|_{x=3} = \frac{1}{8}\).

\( f(x,y)=\int_{0}^{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}tg(x^{2}+y^{2}-t^{2})dt=-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}g(x^{2}+y^{2}-t^{2})d(x^{2}+y^{2}-t^{2}) \)
令 \(x^{2} + y^{2} - t^{2} = u\) ，则
\[
f (x, y) = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} g (u) \mathrm{d} u
\]
故 \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = xg(x^2 +y^2),\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = yg(x^2 +y^2)\)
\[
\left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} \right| _ {(1, 1)} = g (2) = 1, \quad \left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} \right| _ {(1, 1)} = g (2) = 1
\]
\[
\mathrm{d} f \Big | _ {(1, 1)} = \mathrm{d} x + \mathrm{d} y.
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(\alpha\) 为 3 维非零实列向量，\(E\) 为 3 阶单位矩阵，\(A = E - \frac{3}{\alpha^T \alpha} \alpha \alpha^T\)，则 \(tr(A) = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(\operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{A}) = \operatorname{tr}(\mathbf{E}) - \operatorname{tr}\left(\frac{3}{\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha}\alpha \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\right) = 3 - \frac{3}{\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha}\operatorname{tr}(\alpha \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}) = 3 - \frac{3}{\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha}\cdot \alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha\)
\[
= 3 - 3 = 0
\]

questions.stem: 求极限 \(\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\int_0^x du \int_0^u [u^2 - 3\sin(u - t)^2] dt}{\sin x^8}\).

solution.analysis_md:
当 \(x \to 0\) 时, \(\sin x^8 \sim x^8\).
原式 \(= \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_0^x\mathrm{d}u\int_0^x[u^2 - 3\sin (u - t)^2]\mathrm{d}t}{x^8}\xlongequal{\text{洛必达}}\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_0^x[x^2 - 3\sin (x - t)^2]\mathrm{d}t}{8x^7}\)
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {3} - 3 \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sin (x - t) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} t}{8 x ^ {7}}
\]
令 \(x - t = s\) ，则 \(\int_0^x\sin (x - t)^2\mathrm{d}t = \int_0^x\sin s^2\mathrm{d}s\) ，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \text {原式} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {3} - 3 \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sin s ^ {2} \mathrm{d} s}{8 x ^ {7}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 x ^ {2} - 3 \sin x ^ {2}}{5 6 x ^ {6}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {6 x - 3 \cos x ^ {2} \cdot 2 x}{5 6 \cdot 6 x ^ {5}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x (1 - \cos x ^ {2})}{5 6 x ^ {5}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} x ^ {4}}{5 6 x ^ {4}} = \frac {1}{1 1 2} \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem: 设可导函数 \( y = f(x) \) 由方程 \( \mathrm{e}^{x - 2y} - x^2 y = 1 \) 确定, 计算 \( \lim_{x\to 1^{+}}\frac{\sin(x - 1)}{\sqrt{(x - 1)^3}}\int_0^1 f(t\sqrt{x - 1})dt. \)

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(\mathrm{e}^{x - 2y} - x^2 y = 1\)，当 \(x = 0\) 时，\(y = 0\)，即 \(f(0) = 0\).
等式两边对 \(x\) 求导，有 \(\mathrm{e}^{x - 2y}(1 - 2y') - 2xy - x^2 y' = 0.\) 将 \(x = 0, y = 0\) 代入上式，得
\[
f ^ {\prime} (0) = y ^ {\prime} (0) = \frac {1}{2}.
\]
又 \(\int_0^1 f(t\sqrt{x - 1})\mathrm{d}t = \frac{t\sqrt{x - 1} = u}{\sqrt{x - 1}}\frac{1}{0}\int_0^{\sqrt{x - 1}}f(u)\mathrm{d}u\) ，故
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{\sqrt {(x - 1) ^ {3}}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t \sqrt {x - 1}) \mathrm{d} t = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{(x - 1) ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) \mathrm{d} u
\]
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{x - 1} \cdot \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) \mathrm{d} u}{x - 1} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) \mathrm{d} u}{x - 1} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {f (\sqrt {x - 1})}{2 \sqrt {x - 1}}
\]
\[
= \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {f (\sqrt {x - 1}) - f (0)}{\sqrt {x - 1} - 0} = \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} (0) = \frac {1}{4}
\]

(I) \(f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{\int \mathrm{d}x}\left(\int \pi \mathrm{e}^{x}\cos \pi x \cdot \mathrm{e}^{-\int \mathrm{d}x}\mathrm{d}x + C\right) = \mathrm{e}^{x}\left(\int \pi \cos \pi x\mathrm{d}x + C\right)\)
\[
= \mathrm{e} ^ {x} (\sin \pi x + C)
\]
由 \(f(0) = 0\) ，得 \(C = 0\) ，故 \(f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin \pi x\)
(Ⅱ) \( y = e^{x} \sin \pi x \) 在 \([0, n]\) 上与 \( x \) 轴所围图形的面积为
\[
\begin{array}{l} S _ {n} = \int_ {0} ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} | \sin \pi x | \mathrm{d} x = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \int_ {k - 1} ^ {k} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} | \sin \pi x | \mathrm{d} x \\ = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} (- 1) ^ {k - 1} \int_ {k - 1} ^ {k} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \sin \pi x \mathrm{d} x \\ = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} (- 1) ^ {k - 1} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x} (\sin \pi x - \pi \cos \pi x)}{1 + \pi^ {2}} \Bigg | _ {k - 1} ^ {k} \\ = \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} (- 1) ^ {k - 1} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {k} [ 0 - \pi \cdot (- 1) ^ {k} ] - \mathrm{e} ^ {k - 1} [ 0 - \pi (- 1) ^ {k - 1} ]}{1 + \pi^ {2}} \\ = \frac {\pi (\mathrm{e} + 1)}{1 + \pi^ {2}} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {k - 1} = \frac {\pi (\mathrm{e} + 1)}{1 + \pi^ {2}} \cdot \frac {1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {n}}{1 - \mathrm{e}} \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{S_n}{\mathrm{e}^n} = \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{\pi(e + 1)}{1 + \pi^2}\cdot \frac{1}{1 - e}\cdot \frac{1 - e^n}{e^n} = \frac{\pi(e + 1)}{1 + \pi^2}\cdot \frac{1}{e - 1}.\)

questions.stem:
设 \(z = f(u,v)\) 有二阶连续偏导数， \(u = x - 2\sqrt{y},v = x + 2\sqrt{y}\) ，且满足
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} - y \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{2} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 1 2 a \quad (a \neq 0)
\]
(I) 求  \( \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} \) ;
(II) 若 \(\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u} = -3u^2, f(0,v) = -v^3\)，求 \(f(u,v)\) 的极值.

solution.analysis_md:
(I) 由复合函数求导法, 有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \frac {\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \\ \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} = y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u}\right) \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}} \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] + \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \\ y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \\ = y ^ {- 1} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} - 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2} - y\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y^2} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial v^2} - \left(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u^2} - 2\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial v^2}\right) -\)
\[
\frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u}\right)
\]
\[
= 4 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} = 1 2 a
\]
所以 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} = 3a.\)
(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知
\[
\frac {\partial f}{\partial u} = \int 3 a \mathrm{d} v + \varphi_ {1} (u) = 3 a v + \varphi_ {1} (u)
\]
由 \(\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u} = -3u^2\) ，知 \(\varphi_1(u) = -3u^2\)
故 \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} = 3av - 3u^2, f(u, v) = \int (3av - 3u^2) \mathrm{d}u + \varphi_2(v) = 3auv - u^3 + \varphi_2(v)\).
由 \(f(0,v) = -v^3\) ，得 \(\varphi_{2}(v) = -v^{3}\) ，则 \(f(u,v) = 3auv - u^3 -v^3\)
由 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}&=3av-3u^{2}=0,\\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial v}&=3au-3v^{2}=0,\end{aligned}\right. \)  得驻点 \( P_{1}(0,0),P_{2}(a,a). \)
又 \(\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u^2} = -6u, \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u\partial v} = 3a, \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial v^2} = -6v.\)
对于 \(P_{1}(0,0), A = 0, B = 3a, C = 0.\)
由 \(AC - B^{2} = -9a^{2} < 0\) ，知 \(f(u,v)\) 在点 \(P_{1}(0,0)\) 处不取得极值.
对于 \(P_{2}(a,a),A = -6a,B = 3a,C = -6a.\)
由 \(AC - B^{2} = (-6a)(-6a) - 9a^{2} = 27a^{2} > 0\)
当 \(a > 0\) 时，\(A = -6a < 0, f(a, a) = a^3\) 为极大值.
当 \(a < 0\) 时，\(A = -6a > 0, f(a, a) = a^3\) 为极小值.

questions.stem: 设 \( D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\} \) ，计算 \( I=\iint_{D}\max\left\{y+1,\frac{2}{1+x}\right\}dxdy. \)

solution.analysis_md:
\[
\max \left\{y + 1, \frac {2}{1 + x} \right\} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{1 + x}, & (x, y) \in D _ {1} \\ 1 + y, & (x, y) \in D _ {2} \end{array} \right.
\]
故 \(I = \iint_{D_1}\frac{2}{1 + x}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y + \iint_{D_2}(1 + y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\xlongequal{\text{记}} I_1 + I_2.\)
\[
I _ {1} = \iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {2}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \frac {2}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} y
\]
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\frac {2}{1 + x} \cdot \frac {1 - x}{1 + x}\right) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1 - x}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x
\]
\[
= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ \frac {- 1}{1 + x} + \frac {2}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \right] d x = - 2 \ln (1 + x) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} + 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {d (1 + x)}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \right.
\]
\[
= - 2 (\ln 2 - 0) - 4 \frac {1}{1 + x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = - 2 \ln 2 - 4 \left(\frac {1}{2} - 1\right)
\]
\[
= 2 - 2 \ln 2
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} I _ {2} = \iint_ {D _ {2}} (1 + y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} y \int_ {\frac {1 - y}{1 + y}} ^ {\sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} (1 + y) \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 + y) \left(\sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} - \frac {1 - y}{1 + y}\right) d y \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} d y + \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} d y - \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - y) d y \\ = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} d (1 - y ^ {2}) - \left(y - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {2}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} \\ = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {2}{3} (1 - y ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{2} = \frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {1}{6} \right. \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(I = I_{1} + I_{2} = 2 - 2\ln 2 + \frac{\pi}{4} -\frac{1}{6} = \frac{\pi}{4} -2\ln 2 + \frac{11}{6}.\)

(I) 由 \(A \sim B\), 知
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} a _ {i i} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} b _ {i i} \\ | \mathbf {A} | = | \mathbf {B} | \end{array} \right.
\]
即 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}5&=a+5\\ 3&=4a+c\end{aligned}\right. \) ，解得a=0,c=3.
由 \(|\lambda E - A| = (\lambda - 1)^2 (\lambda - 3)\), 知 \(A\) 的特征值为 \(\lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = 1, \lambda_3 = 3\).
由于 A 是实对称矩阵, 知 A 必相似于对角矩阵, 故  \( B = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & b & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & -2 & 4 \end{bmatrix} \)  也可对角化, 且与
A 有相同的特征值, 为  \( \mu_{1} = \mu_{2} = 1, \mu_{3} = 3 \) , 故
\[
\mathrm{r} (\boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {B}) = \mathrm{r} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & - b & - 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & - 3 \end{array} \right] = 1
\]
所以 b = -2.
综上所述， \(a = 0,b = -2,c = 3.\)
(Ⅱ) 由 \( (E-A)X=0 \) ，得特征向量  \( \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}=(-1,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(0,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
由 \( (3E-A)X=0 \) ，得特征向量 \( \alpha_{3}=(1,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
令  \( P_{1}=(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}) \) ，则  \( P_{1}^{-1}AP_{1}=\mathrm{diag}(1,1,3) \) .
由 \( (E-B)X=0 \) ，得特征向量 \( \boldsymbol{\beta}_{1}=(-2,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2}=(3,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
由 \( (3E-B)X=0 \) ，得特征向量 \( \boldsymbol{\beta}_{3}=(1,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
令  \( P_{2}=(\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{3}) \) ，则  \( P_{2}^{-1}BP_{2}=\mathrm{diag}(1,1,3) \) .
故 \(P_{1}^{-1}AP_{1} = P_{2}^{-1}BP_{2}\)
即 \((P_{1}P_{2}^{-1})^{-1}A(P_{1}P_{2}^{-1}) = B\) ，所以
\[
\boldsymbol {P} = \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} \boldsymbol {P} _ {2} ^ {- 1} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right] ^ {- 1}
\]
\[
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ \frac {1}{2} & 1 & - \frac {1}{2} \\ - \frac {1}{2} & - 1 & \frac {3}{2} \end{array} \right]
\]
\[
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{2} & - 2 & \frac {3}{2} \\ - \frac {1}{2} & 0 & \frac {3}{2} \\ \frac {1}{2} & 1 & - \frac {1}{2} \end{array} \right]
\]
则  \( P^{-1}AP = B \) .
（Ⅲ）将（Ⅱ）中  \( \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3} \)  （已正交）单位化，得
\[
\gamma_ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (- 1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \gamma_ {2} = (0, 0, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \gamma_ {3} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}
\]
令 \(Q = (\gamma_{1},\gamma_{2},\gamma_{3})\) ，则 \(Q\) 为正交矩阵，且 \(Q^{\mathrm{T}}AQ = \mathrm{diag}(1,1,3)\)
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {X} \xlongequal {\boldsymbol {X} = \boldsymbol {Q} \boldsymbol {Y}} \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {Y} = y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + 3 y _ {3} ^ {2}
\]
令 \(\begin{bmatrix} y_1 \\ y_2 \\ y_3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} z_1 \\ z_2 \\ z_3 \end{bmatrix}\), 记为 \(Y = P_3 Z\), 则 \(X^T A X \xlongequal{X = Q P_3 Z} z_1^2 + z_2^2 + z_3^2\).
令 \(C_1 = QP_3\) ，则 \(C_1^{\mathrm{T}}AC_1 = E\) ，故 \(\mathbf{A} = (\mathbf{C}_1^{\mathrm{T}})^{-1}\mathbf{C}_1^{-1} = (\mathbf{C}_1^{-1})^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{C}_1^{-1}\)
令 \(C = C_{1}^{-1} = (QP_{3})^{-1} = P_{3}^{-1}Q^{-1} = P_{3}^{-1}Q^{\mathrm{T}}\) ，即
\[
\boldsymbol {C} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \sqrt {3} \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ \sqrt {\frac {3}{2}} & \sqrt {\frac {3}{2}} & 0 \end{array} \right]
\]
使得  \( A = C^{T} C \) .
【注】（Ⅲ）也可用配方法化  \( X^{T}AX \)  为规范形，从而求出可逆矩阵 C，使得  \( A = C^{T}C \) .
